messages.subject: checkboxGroupInput trouble
parts:
I have some code for a group of check boxes. I'm running shiny_0.7.0. 
I'm putting this in one of tabs of my main panel and no matter what I try, nothing is selected by default.
Here is what I have.

checkboxGroupInput("peerParameters", "What consitutes a peer facility?",
choices = c("Same Faclity Type"="sameFT", "Same Class of Trade"="sameCOT", "Same Tax Status"="sameTax"),
selected = c("sameFT", "sameCOT", "sameTax"))

Any suggestions?

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: checkboxGroupInput trouble
parts:
?checkboxGroupInput

choices: List of values to show checkboxes for. If elements of the list are named then that name rather than the value is displayed to the user.
